Next.js reports a known security vulnerability and recommends a security upgrade. The orchestrator must handle that recommendation separately. This UX pass does not approve package security or deployment.

page-check completed all 18 route and viewport checks. Features reports four photographs at 390 and three at desktop widths. The complete Reading thumbnail measures 192x92.16 pixels, below page-check's 120-pixel threshold. Direct Chrome checks confirm that it loads and remains visible. No photograph is hidden, blank, or covered.

Playwright used system Chrome for all six routes at 390, 980, and 1280 pixels. All 18 contexts returned HTTP 200 and one h1. Document and page-main widths equal the viewport. No image failed. No console error, page error, or HTTP error appeared.
All nine Pricing views render exactly four rows. The last total is 2,450 baht or 2,450 บาท. No page-main contains 2,700 or a missing-data marker. No valid locale route shows an error page.
At 390, all three price tables measure 358 pixels. Each remains readable without sideways scrolling. Each table has a caption, three scoped column headers, and four scoped row headers.
All 54 visible-copy checks pass across the nine Pricing views. They cover the v1.2 S1 body, S2 note, S3 heading and body, S6 body, and open S9 first answer.
All 54 FAQ checks opened with Enter and closed with Space. Native focus outlines remain visible. All six Tab checks moved from the first summary to the second.
All 12 CTA clicks reached the locale-specific Tutor or Contact destination. All three Features anchor clicks reached #programs with the heading below the mobile header.

All 18 contrast probes pass their AA text thresholds. Features probes check 58 visible text elements; Pricing probes check 55. The minimum checked ratio is 7.30:1. These probes exclude text inside screenshots.

F1 remains withdrawn: Storytime keeps its complete face and source ratio. F2 remains withdrawn: text-only cards retain automatic height and 25 pixels below the last text. F3 remains withdrawn: three pictured cards fill consecutive desktop rows, with 24-pixel gaps and paired text-only cards afterward.

The five-card order remains unchanged. At 390, all cards occupy one column, with pictures above the text. Desktop picture widths remain 192 pixels. Primary preserves its whole 375x622 source at 192x318.45 pixels.
Compared every fresh preview with the corresponding ux-wfp-r5 image using Pillow RGB pixel differences. All 18 pairs have equal dimensions and no differing pixel. No screenshot hash was introduced.

Viewed all nine fresh Pricing captures, the native open Thai FAQ, the desktop program section, and the mobile Thai Features capture. The other Features captures exactly match the previously viewed and approved r5 captures.

The fresh captures preserve the accepted hierarchy, spacing, labels, section order, and image crops. Thai text wraps without clipped marks, overlap, or truncated controls. Optional missing photographs create no empty image boxes.
The zh routes retain English page copy with Chinese navigation and footer text, as D4 permits. This audit does not claim Chinese translation approval.

Accessibility snapshots preserve headings, named links and images, native disclosures, and four-row table semantics. Existing nested main landmarks and repeated screen-reader table summaries remain outside this remediation.

The browser run uses valid checked-in locale data. It does not inject invalid server messages. Red and Green own the missing-row exception tests. No user-triggered form, loading, or empty-data flow exists in these static pages.
Header measurements across all 18 contexts remain top=0 and bottom=81, with one header. Normal image loading completes without a broken or empty slot.
Stopped only audit server PID 2126345, obtained from ss for port 3123. The final port check shows no listener. No implementation, test, plan, registry, package, or commit changed.

The assigned branch and worktree remain for acceptance and the later merge gate. Other nondefault branches and worktrees remain with their owning sessions. Daniel's outstanding Thai, look, push, and deploy gates remain separate.
